notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Orcish Bowmasters lifelink.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
If needed, give Orcish Bowmasters lifelink.
Activate Krav by paying {B} and sacrificing all Armies you control, or one other creature if you don't control an Army, causing an opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life for each creature sacrificed this way, and for you to put that many +1/+1 counters on Krav.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn this way, dealing that much damage to any target and causing you to gain that much life, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on it for each card drawn.
When the Orc Army enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
